title: Global ERP Solutions Manager 2 - Supply Chain
jd_text: RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No CLEARANCE TYPE: None TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career. Northrop Grumman’s Corporate Sector's Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) is seeking a Global ERP Solutions Manager 2 - Supply Chain to support the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) organization's Global Supply Chain team. The selected candidate will lead a team of highly skilled Level 3 Enterprise Applications Analysts and Technical Experts, while being responsible for architecting new solutions and projects in support of our global SAP S/4HANA platform and related digital solutions. This leader will: Own end‑to‑end solution strategy and technical design for key SAP S/4 and Supply Chain capabilities. Manage Level 3 operations for critical ERP services, ensuring reliable, high‑quality production support. Serve as the primary point of contact between Enterprise Services and Sectors/Divisions/Business Units to translate business strategy and program requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technology solutions. Drive continuous improvement, analytics, and integration capabilities as part of Northrop Grumman’s Supply Chain and ERP digital transformation. A virtual work arrangement may be available; however, the selected candidate will be expected to be within driving distance to a Northrop Grumman office. Periodic travel (up to ~10%) may be required for key program, customer, and team engagements . Key Responsibilities: Solution Ownership & Architecture Lead the solution technical architecture and roadmap for SAP S/4 capabilities with a focus on Global Supply Chain and end‑to‑end business processes. Integrate the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) with SAP business processes to enable workflow, extensions, and analytics. Define and manage Supplier Collaboration scenarios (e.g., purchasing document and attachment exchange) between SAP S/4 and external suppliers/partners. Oversee integration patterns and API configurations involving SAP S/4, Ariba, and other enterprise platforms. Level 3 Technical Operations & Service Delivery Manage a global Level 3 ERP support team responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex issues across multiple SAP service lines. Ensure the overall technical quality, performance, stability, and security of solutions in production, meeting or exceeding business SLAs and customer expectations. Provide oversight to recurring and non‑recurring ERP support activities, including incident management, problem management, and defect remediation across multiple programs, Divisions, and Sectors. Establish and maintain sound technical processes, standards, and methods in accordance with company procedures, quality standards, and project protocols. AI / ML & Intelligent Automation Evaluate and recommend AI/ML tools, platforms, and frameworks appropriate for integration into the ERP — including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and process optimization use cases. Support the design of data pipelines and infrastructure (data lakes, model serving layers) that enable AI/ML workloads within compliant government IT boundaries. Collaborate with organizational stakeholders to translate AI capability needs into actionable ERP/Supply Chain infrastructure requirements. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary liaison between CIDO and Sector/Division/Business Unit leadership for ERP and Supply Chain solutions. Collaborate with program leadership, homeroom managers, functional leaders, and end‑user groups to identify, prioritize, and deliver ERP capabilities that support program strategic and tactical objectives. Translate business strategy and domain roadmaps into executable technology plans, balancing near‑term needs with long‑term platform health and scalability. Partner with Supplier Management, Procurement, and Operations teams to continuously improve supplier collaboration, visibility, and performance through SAP capabilities. Delivery Leadership & Continuous Improvement Support the design, development, integration/test, and deployment of new ERP and digital capabilities, including coordination across internal teams and external partners. Manage project and support budgets/schedules for assigned programs and initiatives; monitor performance and proactively address risks and issues. Implement and champion Continuous Improvement practices to optimize ERP capabilities, streamline processes, and improve user experience, aligned to Northrop Grumman’s digital transformation objectives. Where applicable, leverage SAP ACTIVATE Methodology to manage and de-risk implementations. People Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically dispersed team of Level 3 Enterprise Applications Analysts. Set clear priorities and manage capacity, and staffing across the global ERP support team. Foster a culture of customer focus, technical excellence, accountability, and innovation. Promote knowledge sharing, cross‑training, and succession planning within the team. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Manufacturing, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline and 8 years relevant experience; OR Master’s degree with 6 years of relevant experience. Significant hands‑on experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA applications supporting core business processes (preferably in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations). 5+ years of experience in at least one of the following: Solution architecture or enterprise architecture for SAP S/4 and related platforms OR, Technical leadership of Level 3 ERP support teams in a complex, multi‑business‑unit environment. Demonstrated experience with: SAP configuration in Supply Chain / Procurement or related functional areas. At least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (design through go‑live and stabilization). Designing or supporting integrations between SAP and external systems (APIs, middleware, BTP, or Ariba). Proven project/program management experience, including planning, scheduling, budget/cost awareness, risk management, and status reporting. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from technical teams to non‑technical business users and Executive Leadership; strong presentation skills. Experience successfully deploying business process capabilities into a Production environment and sustaining them through structured support processes. Customer‑focused, results‑oriented leader with demonstrated ability to drive cross‑functional teams to action in a matrixed organization. Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment and can quickly learn program and process contexts. Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Systems Engineering, Supply Chain/Manufacturing Management, Computer Science, or related STEM discipline. Deep experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Materials Management. Hands‑on experience with: SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for extensions and integrations. SAP Analytics Cloud configuration and solution delivery. Supplier Collaboration integrations between SAP S/4 and external vendors/portals. Ariba configuration, especially Sourcing and Supplier Lifecycle & Performance modules. Prior Enterprise Services or shared‑services environment experience; familiarity with global ERP operating models. Defense industry and/or aerospace & defense experience, with understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements. Demonstrated application of Continuous Improvement concepts, methods, and tools (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) to IT/ERP processes. Experience leading Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban) with a strong understanding of Agile ceremonies and metrics. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to challenge the status quo and propose innovative, practical solutions to complex requirements. We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivate your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us! Primary Level Salary Range: $133,200.00 - $199,800.00 The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business. The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. title: Senior Maximo Business Analyst
jd_text: Job Type: Regular Plains is an industry-leading transportation and midstream provider specializing in transportation, storage, processing and marketing solutions for crude oil. We own an extensive network of pipeline transportation, terminalling, storage and gathering assets in key oil producing basins and transportation corridors and at major market hubs in the United States and Canada. The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas. We’re on the lookout for passionate self‑starters who thrive in fast‑moving, collaborative, and innovative environments. Role Purpose/Summary: The Maximo Business System Owner is the principle point of stakeholder coordination and end-user system management for the PAA instance of the Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) system. They play a critical collaboration, planning, and work execution role between the Operations, Commercial (Trucking), and IS teams to ensure that operational business requirements are properly captured, related system functions are enabled, and system configurations changes made by IS are adopted effectively by the respective business teams. Their portfolio of oversight and execution of work within Maximo spans three core areas of End-user Management, Data Management, and System Configuration Change Management. This is an office-based role but requires a detailed understanding of field operations, maintenance, and safety work practices, as well as detailed technical knowledge of Maximo and related technology elements (e.g., system data structures, system administration / security practices, system configuration testing, etc.). The selected candidate will be eligible for company benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), and Free Parking. Responsibilities: Engage with the respective stakeholder teams from Commercial (Trucking), Operations, Engineering, and HSE at least monthly to provide updates on supported initiatives, forthcoming system changes, or new system capabilities that may be of interest. Support business process improvement efforts that can leverage system capabilities to enhance work execution, including documenting process changes and business scoping or functional requirements. Work with stakeholders and the technology function to define a multi-year roadmap for system capabilities development aligned to emerging business requirements. Capture, prioritize, and manage stakeholder system initiatives and enhancements through to completion. Oversee larger project efforts that require new or significantly enhanced system capabilities or integration with other systems. Act as the primary point of contact with IS for the PAA Maximo instance and work to debottleneck application management support to ensure timely system improvements (i.e., find ways to accelerate backlog resolution). Plan and oversee testing of all system changes for the respective instances prior to implementation. Collaborate with other team members to ensure training / reference guides necessary to adopt system changes are developed and provided to stakeholders. Provide direct business support to resolve end user issues, progress business initiatives, and accelerate system enhancements. Analyze / evaluate end-user system issues that arise and identify mitigations or potential solutions. Assist with functional requirements gathering and system configuration design. Exercise critical decision making and discretion in performing tasks; redirect solution implementation if desired results were not originally met. Communicate effectively with departmental team members and management to ensure alignment of expectations, work progress, and outcomes achieved. Demonstrate safe work practices following Plains’ safety policies and procedures. Responsible for informing senior personnel of hazard identification and near misses. Responsible for completing other related duties that may be assigned based on operational requirements and priorities. Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required: Requires a 4-year college degree in STEM or a related discipline. A minimum of five years of experience in a technical analysis, maintenance / reliability, or engineering role. Ability to speak, read, and write English and the ability to perform basic math. Detailed knowledge across a broad range of field operations, maintenance, and safety work practices. Experience managing end users, data, and system configurations for EAM and related software platforms. Ability to work in a team-based work environment, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. Maintains a thorough knowledge of Plains’ O&M Manual, specifications, and forms used to document inspection and maintenance activities. Must have a detailed knowledge of the Maximo EAM platform and related technologies. Must have comprehensive computer skills and experience using Microsoft Office suite with strong emphasis on Excel and/or other spreadsheet applications. title: EPIC Revenue Cycle Senior Reporting Business Analyst
jd_text: Job Category: Administrative & Clerical Work Shift/Schedule: 8 Hr Morning - Afternoon Northeast Georgia Health System is rooted in a foundation of improving the health of our communities. Prior experience providing production level support and/or development in business intelligence (BI) environments. Excellent SQL skills - with the ability to write complex queries that perform well against high volume datasets. Strong knowledge and experience in data warehouse concepts, enterprise data management practices, participation in strategy discussions is needed. title: Business Capability Architect - IT Management
jd_text: RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career. Northrop Grumman’s Corporate Sector Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) is seeking a Senior Staff Computer Systems Architect to serve as the Business Capability Architect – IT Management , owning the current- and target-state architecture for IT Management capabilities across the enterprise within the Strategy and Architecture team of the Governance & Strategy organization. This role is aligned to the target architecture operating model in which the Head of Strategy and Architecture leads within the Chief Information and Digital Office (CIDO). The IT Management Business Capability Architect is responsible for guiding capability evolution across IT planning, governance, service management, operational oversight, tooling alignment, and related management processes so that enterprise standards translate into one coherent capability roadmap rather than disconnected local improvements. The successful candidate will: Own the current-state and target-state architecture for the IT Management capability across organizational and solution boundaries. Define capability roadmaps spanning platforms, workflows, data exchanges, operating processes, and modernization initiatives that support IT Management outcomes. Partner with business, application, data, technology, security, infrastructure, and delivery stakeholders to improve coherence in IT Management decisions. Help translate enterprise architecture direction into practical capability priorities, sequencing, and transformation guidance for IT Management outcomes. This position will be available as a virtual telecommuter, however, the incumbent most be within 90 miles of a major Northrop Grumman location for ad hoc onsite meetings. Key Responsibilities: Serve as the Business Capability Architect for the IT Management capability. Define and maintain the current-state and target-state architecture for IT Management across the enterprise. Develop capability roadmaps that span multiple systems, services, products, and initiatives supporting IT Management functions. Translate enterprise standards, architecture methods, and target-state direction into capability-specific architecture guidance for IT Management. Identify dependencies, sequencing needs, reuse opportunities, and trade-offs across the IT Management portfolio. Guide solution and delivery teams so initiatives supporting IT Management advance one coherent target state rather than optimize locally. Partner with stakeholders across Governance & Strategy, Enterprise Applications, IT Infrastructure & Operations, CISO & Global Cybersecurity, Insights & Intelligence, and other enabling functions where capability alignment is required. Support enterprise decision-making by clarifying capability outcomes, process implications, data dependencies, and operating-model impacts tied to IT Management modernization. Escalate enterprise-level standards conflicts, investment trade-offs, or cross-capability issues to the Business Architecture Lead and Chief Enterprise Architect as appropriate. Contribute patterns, lessons learned, and roadmap updates back into the broader architecture practice. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field and 14+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 12+ years, or a PhD with 10+ years. Candidates must have the ability to obtain, and maintain, a U.S. Government Secret level security clearance as a condition of continued employment. Strong experience in architecture for business capabilities, enterprise business systems, IT management processes, or complex cross-functional portfolios. Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries and connect target-state design to delivery planning and operational outcomes. Experience creating roadmaps, patterns, and architecture guidance across multiple solutions, systems, or services. Strong stakeholder-management and influence skills across business and technology organizations. Ability to operate as both strategist and practical architectural guide for a capability area. Experience in regulated, security-conscious, or compliance-driven environments. Knowledge of BIZBOK style capability, Value Streams, org mapping, business process design. Working knowledge of TOGAF ADM. Preferred Qualifications: Prior experience in enterprise, business, domain, or capability architecture roles. Experience supporting IT governance, IT service management, enterprise tooling, operational oversight, infrastructure-related management processes, or shared IT operating functions. Experience in defense, aerospace, federal, or similarly regulated environments. Experience mentoring delivery architects while maintaining common architecture standards. Ability to connect business capability planning with operational execution, modernization investments, and enterprise service outcomes. Experience working with matrixed stakeholders across strategy, infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, and analytics functions. We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. At Northrop Grumman, we are on the cutting edge of innovation. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivating your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule option, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us!! Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business. title: Senior Regional Sales Rep
jd_text: WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH As part of the North America Regional Sales team, this role reports to the North America Regional Sales Director and serves as a key connection between Nike and strategic regional retail partners. This individual thrives in a fast-moving environment, balances strategic thinking with executional excellence, and uses data to make informed business decisions. title: Instrumentation/Electric Technician - Lead
jd_text: #WeAreONEOK – Fortune 500 company. 100+ years in business. Leading midstream service provider. Safety first. Sustainable operations. Environmentally responsible. Employee focused. JOB SUMMARY Looking for a career opportunity? Come join ONEOK as a Lead Instrumentation & Electrician Technician in Mentone, TX. This position will work in the field and at the Lobo Plant. Experience with instrumentation, electric, programmable logic control systems (PLC), distributed control systems (DCS), calibrations, and troubleshooting equipment is a plus. ONEOK offers generous health benefits, 401k, life insurance, LTD/STD, paid time off benefits, and more. Don’t miss this exciting opportunity to work at a Fortune 500 company, apply today! Job Profile Summary Leads or performs a specialized level of work including installation, troubleshooting, calibrating, maintaining and repair of various electrical/electronic, pneumatic, hydraulic, analyzers, measurement, control and automation systems, and related equipment. Essential Functions and Responsibilities Install, operate, inspect, troubleshoot, repair, calibrate/adjust, and maintain the following equipment including but not limited to: Calorimeters Gravitometers/Densitometers Chromatographs Telemetering systems Moisture analyzers ESD systems/UPS systems Electronic odorization systems Flow computers PH and conductivity probes Instrumentation Meter tubes and orifice plates Satellite equipment Analytical equipment Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition system and remote terminal units and equipment Distributed Control System (DCS) Programmable Logic Control (PLC) systems Perform preventative maintenance and/or analytical testing on compressors/engines, drivers, and auxiliary equipment Maintain electrical power circuits, switch gear, and power distribution including high voltage Perform and/or observe measurement equipment witness tests Install and maintain security/intrusion systems Drive and ensure maintenance is complete on company vehicles Maintain, calculate, prepare, and approve reports and records including but not limited to: Maintenance and repair records Safety and environmental reports Mechanical drawings Electrical schematics and diagrams Pressure readings Material and supply orders Loop sheets Meter tube/orifice plate ratios Orifice and positive meter flow rates and capacities Work planning Work procedures Responsibilities may include Department of Transportation (DOT) covered functions, including operations, maintenance, or emergency response on a pipeline. title: Commercialization Project Manager
jd_text: Who We Are: Nutrabolt is a fast-growing, global active health and wellness company with a portfolio of market leading performance-oriented brands that energize and fuel active lifestyles. The company’s disruptive and innovative products compete in the Functional Beverage and Active Nutrition segments, under three consumer-loved brands: C4 ® (one of the fastest-growing energy drink brands in the United States and the #1 selling global pre-workout brand), XTEND ® (the #1 post-workout recovery brand in the United States), and Cellucor ® (an award-winning sports nutrition brand created in 2002). Since its founding 20 years ago, Nutrabolt has set out to meet the discerning needs of performance athletes and fitness enthusiasts, while appealing beyond this core group to include consumers around the globe who are making healthy, active living a daily priority. As a Certified Great Place to Work, Top Workplaces USA honoree, Fortune Best Workplace in Texas, and more – Nutrabolt cares deeply about our people, planet, and the communities we serve. Here, our teammates are united by our mission, and take ownership in creating a healthy workplace environment that promotes strong bodies, clear minds, and a culture of respect and belonging for all. Who You Are: As a Commercialization Project Manager, you will be the timeline and prioritization subject matter expert responsible for creating project timelines aligned with cross-functional partners for your assigned projects (Brand, Product Development, Sourcing, Creative, Regulatory and Quality, Commercial team, etc.) You will proactively monitor your assigned project plans to make sure that all milestones are achieved and helping to keep internal teams organized and on track What You're Good At: Ensure Project/Product scope is clearly defined, establishing project owner/sponsor and identifying core project team, across key New Product Innovation, Renovation, and Line Extension projects. Ensure project roadmap as defined remains on track. Own commercialization timelines. Review current timelines, understand cross-functional team needs and pain points and improve timeline structure. Actively manage timelines from concept to launch. Ensure that all cross-functional parties understand their role in the timeline to aid in delivering on key milestones. Anticipate, mitigate, and escalate possible delays in deliverables with corrective action plans. Hold effective status meetings and work with the cross-functional team to ensure dashboards and reports are maintained accurately to support the management and tracking of progress of all project activities & schedules. Ensure there is a clear purpose, agenda, and action item review for each meeting. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and activities, supporting the team in success now, and as the organization continues to scale. Work effectively with Brand Marketing, Commercial, Operations, Product Development, R&D, Quality, Finance, Regulatory and other key stakeholders by building strong and meaningful relationships. Identify and create meaningful, relevant measurements and reporting to facilitate learning and improvement for assigned projects. Perform other duties as necessary What You Contribute: Bachelor’s degree preferred. 5+ years of experience in project management, preferably within commercialization of CPGs You’re self-motivated with effective project, prioritization, and time-management skills, with a desire and ability to balance multiple high priority and high visibility projects simultaneously. You love the challenge of figuring things out and making an impact right away. You are highly organized, with an innate ability to connect the dots and understand the knock-on implications of actions or delays to cross functional teams. You keep project teams on the same page through incredible communication skills and can quickly build relationships, while also keeping people accountable. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite Programs Familiarity with project management tools and principles Familiarity with cost of goods and P&L management Ability to build trust and confidence by sharing information, presenting research and data objectively, and providing feedback confidently. Excellent written and verbal communications skills; able to effectively communicate cross-functionally and through all levels of management. Entrepreneurial spirit and enthusiasm Team player, with the ability to inspire and be inspired by many different types of people and roles. Why Nutrabolt? Wellness Benefits Nutrabolt cares about our teammates’ physical, mental, and financial wellness by providing benefits like: competitive health insurance, life insurance, mental wellness programs, 401K matching, and a Lifestyle Spending Account. Lifestyle Perks We offer unlimited vacation paid time off and volunteer time off. You’ll get discounts on C4 Energy, Cellucor, and XTEND products, too! Family Support We want you to reach your full potential at work by taking care of all loved ones at home. We provide paid parental leave, in addition to reimbursement for expenses related to childcare, fertility treatments, legal fees, and more through our Lifestyle Spending Account. Nutrabolt is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Please review our CCPA policy here. title: Manufacturing Technician II - (T2) Weekend Shift
jd_text: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $20.00 - $27.50 Location: Austin,TX You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .
